bullets.id: Emas naik 1,5% ke $4.194,36 pada Jumat, kenaikan hari kedua berturut-turut, dan menuju kenaikan mingguan sekitar 1,3% setelah menyentuh level terendah dua bulan pada Rabu. Sentimen konsumen Michigan turun ke 46,3, di bawah perkiraan 47,6, sementara ekspektasi inflasi setahun naik ke 4,7%. Trump menyebut pembicaraan dengan Iran produktif dan tidak ada serangan sebelum pemilu 3 November.
bullets.en: Gold rose 1.5% to $4,194.36 on Friday, its second straight daily gain, and headed for a weekly gain of about 1.3% after touching a two-month low on Wednesday. Michigan consumer sentiment fell to 46.3, below the 47.6 forecast, while one-year inflation expectations rose to 4.7%. Trump called talks with Iran productive and said there would be no attack before the November 3 election.

bullets.id: Brent turun dari atas $104 ke sekitar $102,6 dan yield 10 tahun mundur ke sekitar 5,25% dari puncak dua dekade. Namun Fed belum melunak: CME FedWatch memberi peluang 19% kenaikan suku bunga Oktober dan 84% setidaknya satu kenaikan hingga Desember. Emas masih turun 2,86% sebulan dan sekitar 25% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: Brent fell from above $104 to about $102.6 and the 10-year yield eased to about 5.25% from a two-decade high. But the Fed has not softened: CME FedWatch puts the odds of an October hike at 19% and of at least one hike by December at 84%. Gold is still down 2.86% on the month and about 25% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Resistance berikutnya di $4.225, lalu $4.271 dan $4.311. Support di $4.184, $4.142 dan $4.103, dengan $4.000 sebagai lantai psikologis yang menurut StoneX mulai terbentuk. Pemicu utama pekan depan adalah data inflasi CPI dan PPI AS bulan September.
bullets.en: The next resistance is $4,225, then $4,271 and $4,311. Support sits at $4,184, $4,142 and $4,103, with $4,000 as the psychological floor that StoneX says has been building. The main catalysts next week are the US September CPI and PPI inflation data.

bullets.id: Antam naik Rp20.000 ke Rp2.592.000/gram dan buyback naik Rp25.000 ke Rp2.401.000, sehingga spread menyempit ke Rp191.000 (sekitar 7,4%). Galeri24 Rp2.516.000 (buyback Rp2.371.000) dan UBS Rp2.539.000 (buyback Rp2.345.000). Bank sentral China membeli 21 ton emas pada September, terbesar dalam tiga tahun, bulan ke-23 berturut-turut.
bullets.en: Antam rose Rp20,000 to Rp2,592,000/gram and buyback rose Rp25,000 to Rp2,401,000, narrowing the spread to Rp191,000 (about 7.4%). Galeri24 is at Rp2,516,000 (buyback Rp2,371,000) and UBS at Rp2,539,000 (buyback Rp2,345,000). China’s central bank bought 21 tonnes of gold in September, its largest in three years and its 23rd straight month.
